description:
Niko's Scavengable Industries

Requires MagicLib, LazyLib and LunaLib, with optional Patchlib integration!

Use Building Menu Overhaul for full functionality.

Adds a number (eleven, currently) of industries obtainable through looting, markets, and raiding!

These industries generally fill niche roles vanilla industries do not satisfy.

Examples
Orbital Flak Cannons: Uses ground defenses to establish a terrain that deals damage to hostile fleets near the colony. Fires shots in-combat too!
Innovation Shipworks: Adds s-mods to your faction's fleets-but only if the market its on is the primary ship hull supplier...
Nebula Skimming: Siphons gas from Nebulae the planet passes through, processing it into volatiles.
Cryosanctum: Cryosanctum

Additionally, has LunaSettings that optionally enable vanilla and certain modded industries be unavailable from the start and added to the loot pool. Total blueprint drop weight is increased proportionally when this happens.

Compatibility
Can be added to existing saves, but not removed. Run NSISetupFactionIndustries if adding to a new save.
FAQ
How do I get blueprints from raiding?
Find the largest colony of a faction and raid it. They should have a rather expensive option to raid for industry blueprints.
Does this dilute exploration/store loot pools?
Nope! It has its own pool it draws from.
If it doesn't dilute the pools, this just increases the credit value of loot I get!
True. However, with Patchlib, blueprint sell price is uncoupled from buy price and capped at 50k. Your profits are seriously limited!
Is this compatible with AOTD?
Theoretically, yes.
Blueprints aren't dropping enough! I can't get every industry in a playthrough!
You're not intended to. The default drop coefficient is calculated so you'll only get about 70% of the industries from exploration. Use LunaSettings to increase drop rate.
Was AI used in the creation of this mod?
Only Intellij's simple autocomplete function, which is barely AI powered to begin with.

Download: https://github.com/nikothedude/niko_scavengeableindustries/releases
Repo: https://github.com/nikothedude/niko_scavengeableindustries

Changelog
1.0.0
NOT SAVE COMPATIBLE

Full release

Fixed a bug with factions not knowing their bps at game start

0.5.0
MAYBE SAVE COMPATIBLE - TODO TEST

ASB Terrain now has a per-instance VFX cooldown instead of per-fleet
ASB Flak shots can now optionally have a warning icon for their landing hspot

Blast core mining now increases output further

Added an option to the largest market of a faction to raid for industry BPs

Fixed a bug with planetary defense network delays stacking

0.4.0
PROBABLY SAVE COMPATIBLE

New industry - Planetary Defense Network
Sidegrade to Military Base
REQUIRES BUILDING MENU OVERHAUL OR IT WONT SPAWN!

Spawns 5 heavy patrols in orbit of the colony - 1 light patrol if improved
Delays incoming raids by 30 days
Caps colony size to 5
Much cheaper than a military base
+2x ground defense

Intended for use on outer colonies without much defense, or fortress worlds

Military markets much more likely to sell military industry BPs
Spruced up industry BPs + added design types
Added a few lunasettings

Added the cryosanctum crisis
Spy bureau cannot be added if you dont have enough industries

0.3.2
SAVE COMPATIBLE

Fixes an issue with the spy bureau second industry

0.3.1

PROBABLY SAVE COMPATIBLE

Patchlib content disabled - it wasnt ready yet

Industry BP renamed/recolored
Blast core mining improvement now prevents tectonic activity from being added
Industry knowledge distribution now determined by hmod tags
Allows for things like HMI to get scavenger bps

0.3.0
PROBABLY SAVE COMPATIBLE

Fixed a bug with deficits and innovation shipworks
Fixed ASB terrain not moving with rift gen

Patchlib soft required now

Enabled indevo lock option
Added vanilla lock option

New industry - Artificial Shrine
Makes luddic majority still be active even if you have mining and such as long as pather interest is at or below 10
Also improves immigration rate

Improved scaling math for shop and droprate

Industry BPs now cost a ton more if buying them from a shop

0.2.2

Fixed a typo in innovation shipworks
Fixed a bug with STC districts showing blurbs when inappropiate

Reduced sell freq of bps

Spy bureau spawns fleets fsater
Improved spy fleet AI
Spy bureau now adds a 0.5x crisis mult (NOT save compatible)
Training grounds now accepts military markets
ASB Uplink combat performance nerfed

0.2.1

Fixes a crash without MCTE
Fixes indevo industries being added even when disabled

0.2.0

Flak cannons are now an industry and fire in combat

0.1.0

Release into beta

discordPostHtml:
Adds a few ways to customize your faction beyond just name!

Has optional Patchlib integration. Additionally, use Building Menu Overhaul to enable certain sidegrade industries (optional).

Adds a number (eleven, currently) of industries obtainable through looting, markets, and raiding! (Additionally, has an optional set of lunasettings to add vanilla and certain modded industries to this pool and remove them from gamestart knowledge.)

Can be added to an existing save, but not removed. Run NSISetupFactionIndustries if adding to a new save.

More information present on forum thread.

Download: https://github.com/nikothedude/niko_scavengeableindustries/releases
Forum thread: https://fractalsoftworks.com/forum/index.php?topic=36195.0

AI Disclaimer - No AI was used in the creation of this mod.
